children: Aixia has secured a new order from an existing customer operating in the international automotive industry. The agreement, with an initial value of approximately SEK 4 million, covers an expansion of the customer's existing data protection and recovery infrastructure. The investment forms part of the customer's continued efforts to strengthen the security, availability and resilience of its IT infrastructure. Delivery is expected during the fourth quarter of 2026.

As artificial intelligence and advanced software development become increasingly important across the automotive industry, the requirements for protecting and managing business-critical information continue to grow. Increasing data volumes, complex IT environments and greater reliance on digital systems are making robust data protection and recovery capabilities an essential part of long-term IT strategies.

The order represents a further development of the customer's existing data protection infrastructure and is intended to support its growing need for secure and reliable information management. The solution will help strengthen the customer's ability to maintain business continuity and recover critical data in the event of operational disruptions or cyber incidents.

The agreement further demonstrates Aixia's ability to establish long-term customer relationships and deliver solutions across multiple business-critical technology areas, ranging from advanced AI and data center infrastructure to cybersecurity and data protection.
Mattias Bergkvist, CEO of Aixia and Deputy Group CEO of White Pearl Technology Group, comments:

"As companies continue to invest in AI and advanced digital development, data is becoming one of their most valuable assets. The ability to protect and recover that information is essential for business continuity. We are proud to once again be entrusted with expanding an existing customer's infrastructure. This demonstrates that our expertise in data security and advanced IT infrastructure plays an important role in our customers' long-term technology development."
The order has an initial value of approximately SEK 4 million, with delivery expected during the fourth quarter of 2026.
The company's Certified Adviser is Amudova AB

White Pearl Technology Group AB (WPTG) is a Swedish global technology company specialising in digital transformation solutions. With a presence in over 20 countries and a team of 950 experts, WPTG helps organisations navigate the complexities of the digital age, offering services ranging from ICT and system integration to business software and digital innovation. The company is listed on Nasdaq First North (WPTGB) in Stockholm, Sweden and on OTCQX (WPTGF) in the U.S.
